chunks: ʿAlī ibn Ibrāhīm, from his father, from Ibn Abī ʿUmayr, from Ḥammād ibn ʿUthmān, from Burayd ibn Muʿāwiyah, who said:
I heard Abā ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام saying: “Indeed, in the book of ʿAlī عليه السلام, it is written: the drinker of wine is lashed eighty times, and the drinker of nabīdh is lashed eighty times.”

key_terms.ثَمَانِينَ: eighty, the number of lashes prescribed here
key_terms.شَارِبُ النَّبِيذِ: the one who drinks nabīdh, an intoxicating drink
key_terms.كِتَابِ عَلِيٍّ: the written record attributed to Imam ʿAlī عليه السلام containing legal rulings
key_terms.يُضْرَبُ: is to be lashed or struck as a legal punishment

ai.seo_question: What is the hadd punishment for drinking wine or nabīdh in Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith states a legal ruling transmitted by Imam al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام from the Book of ʿAlī عليه السلام regarding the punishment for consuming intoxicating drinks. It establishes that both wine and nabīdh incur the same hadd punishment of eighty lashes.
